tasks.short: Plan or direct actual spa services and programs.

steps.what: Check actual client demand, services, staff qualifications, room capacity and program results
inputs: actual spa services and measured program demand/results
actual staff and facility constraints

steps.what: Choose actual spa service/program objectives, content, staffing, resources and operating conditions
inputs: checked actual spa service/program context
actual business goals and client/service needs

steps.what: Record and check final service/program plan and instructions using actual chosen fields
inputs: actual chosen service/program plan decisions
checked actual spa service/program context
outputs: checked final service/program plan and actual staff recipients

steps.what: Save checked final spa service/program plan
inputs: checked final service/program plan and actual staff recipients

steps.what: Deliver exact checked service/program plan and instructions to actual responsible staff
inputs: checked final service/program plan and actual staff recipients

steps.what: Direct actual spa service/program delivery and address live service and client problems
inputs: actual service/program instructions delivered
actual staff activity and client/service conditions
outputs: actual directed service/program delivery and observed issues

tasks.design: Configure native service/capacity views in {OPS_SYSTEM}, {CRM} and {HCM}, with repeated plan fields in {DOCS}. Retain actual service choices and direction, checking final written instructions before separate save and staff delivery through {CHAT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Program planning can repeat service/capacity lookup and stable plan entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views and plan fields can reduce repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Real client needs and service feasibility require management judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The manager adjusts a program when the actual service conditions differ from the plan.
tasks.altitude: Less plan administration; service direction stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native service/capacity views and plan fields can support spa programs; they do not choose suitable programs or direct live services.

assumptions: Actual booking/service owners produce demand/results and facility constraints; actual staff owners supply qualification/availability. S1 checks freshness and actual metrics, not assumed satisfaction or demand.

S2 retains all program choices; s3 reduces repeated service/resource fields only while retaining new instructions and complete final checking. Planning and direction may be separate assignments: remove unused branches and reweight. Each actual changed written instruction returns to final-content checking and its own send; s6 does not hide an automated notice.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native functions first; existing views/prefill earn zero saving. Save/delivery each retain one percent using existing checking. Shared facility scheduling under 17605 counted once; no staff labour saving claimed.
unknowns: Which actual service plan fields and lookup repeat?
research_questions: Can native views reduce administration after full service-feasibility checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual service/capacity links and plan fields.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final service/program plan and exact record destination; edits require recheck
s3 exact final service/program instructions and intended staff recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 lookup + 20*0.20 repeated fields = 10; minus 1 upkeep = 9. Half eligible gives 5 minus 1 = 4. Actual program choices, new instructions, final checking, save/send and direction retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Direct actual spa facility maintenance or repair.

inputs: actual facility/equipment condition
actual staff fault reports

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual asset history, maintenance requirements and available responsible repair contacts
inputs: actual captured maintenance needs and immediate constraints
actual asset/service records and repair contacts
outputs: checked actual maintenance context and service options

steps.what: Choose actual maintenance priority, scope, service timing and permitted repair assignment
inputs: checked actual maintenance context and service options
actual service disruption, budget and repair advice

steps.what: Prepare and check final repair instruction with exact asset, scope, timing and authorised recipient
inputs: actual chosen maintenance/repair direction
checked actual maintenance context and service options

steps.what: Deliver exact checked maintenance/repair instruction through actual authorised assignment route
inputs: checked final actual repair instruction and permitted recipient

steps.what: Direct actual repair coordination and inspect actual completed work and unresolved defects
inputs: actual maintenance/repair assignment delivered

inputs: checked final actual maintenance outcome record

tasks.design: Configure native asset/history links and repeated repair-instruction fields in the facilities module of {OPS_SYSTEM}, using {DOCS} for approved references. Retain actual need assessment and repair direction, checking final instructions before separate delivery through {OPS_SYSTEM} or {EMAIL}, and actual outcomes before separate record save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repair direction can repeat asset-history navigation and stable asset fields.
tasks.enabler_now: Native asset/request fields can reduce repeated administration.
tasks.still_hard: Repair priority, service disruption and actual completion require inspection and coordination.
tasks.human_edge: The manager notices unresolved defects despite a contractor's completion claim.
tasks.altitude: Less repair administration; facility judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native asset/history/request fields can assist maintenance direction; they do not diagnose faults, repair equipment or verify completion.

assumptions: Actual manager/staff produce initial fault observations; asset owner supplies history and contacts. Retained s1/s3 capture actual need and scope decisions; s4 cuts stable asset/contact copying only and retains complete instruction/authority checking.

Assignment is within actual manager authority. External contractor delivery uses external authority; internal staff route uses internal delivery authority. Contract acceptance/spend, if separately required, is its own exact-final-terms gated action. All changed instructions return to final checking/send; no hidden machine assignment.

Actual repair staff labour excluded. Actual outcome only after s6, not inferred from assignment. Shares are provisional, not measured; native fields first and existing prefill earns zero saving. Save/send each retain one percent using existing checks; shared hygiene/fault evidence counted once.
unknowns: Which actual asset fields and history lookup repeat?
research_questions: Can native fields reduce repair administration after complete scope and outcome checks?

incremental.description: Maintain actual asset/history/contact mappings and request fields.

approvals.approved_version: s4 exact checked final asset/scope/timing instruction and authorised repair recipient; edits void approval
s7 checked final actual completion/defect record and exact asset destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 history lookup + 18*0.30 repeated instruction fields = 11.4; minus 1 upkeep = 10.4. Half eligible gives 5.7 minus 1 = 4.7. Actual needs, direction, complete checks, delivery, inspection and outcome capture/save retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in continuing education to maintain industry knowledge.

steps.what: Find and verify actual continuing-education class content and relevant spa-industry learning needs
inputs: actual industry knowledge gaps
actual class/provider content and requirements
outputs: checked applicable class and source context

steps.what: Participate in actual continuing education classes and learn current industry information
inputs: checked applicable class and source context
actual class instruction, exercises and questions
outputs: actual class participation and learned information

steps.what: Record and check actual useful learning or completion evidence where required
inputs: actual class participation and learned information
actual provider-issued completion evidence if any

steps.what: Save checked actual continuing-education learning or completion record
inputs: checked final actual learning/completion record

tasks.design: Configure native class/source links in {LMS} and {DOCS}. Retain actual learning and participation, with any actual useful-learning/completion capture/check followed by a separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Class preparation can repeat source navigation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native class/source links can reduce retrieval.
tasks.still_hard: Current industry knowledge requires actual learning and evaluation.
tasks.human_edge: The manager recognises which new information is relevant to the actual spa.
tasks.altitude: Less class lookup; education stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native class/source links can assist preparation; they do not attend classes or establish learning.

assumptions: Actual provider supplies class content; manager checks relevance and retains full substantive study/participation. Actual completion evidence exists only after provider-issued outcome, not enrolment.

Record only if actually required or useful, not mandatory class reports; remove unused branch and reweight. Any actual enrolment request is a separately final-request checked send before the class, not created from later completion evidence; no avoided enrolment time claimed.
Shares are provisional, not measured. Preparation once per actual class, not per attendee. Native links first; existing access earns zero saving. Save retains one percent using existing checking.
research_questions: Can native links reduce navigation while preserving actual learning?

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final actual learning/completion record and exact destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.40 lookup = 4; minus 0.5 upkeep = 3.5. Half eligible gives 2 minus 0.5 = 1.5. Actual class participation, new learning record capture/check and save retained.
